events.title: John Lennon's "Imagine" album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album "Imagine" was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's enduring message
angles.copy: Forty-one years ago today, John Lennon released his seminal album, "Imagine". Its title track remains an anthem for peace and unity. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate the 75th birthday of legendary musician, songwriter, and former Police frontman, Sting.

angles.name: Sting's diverse career
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to Sting! From The Police to his diverse solo work, he's given us decades of incredible music. What's your favourite Sting track?

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when this changed everything? The first iPod was released on this day in 2001. Did you have one of the originals?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, "Dr. No," in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moments
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your top 007 moment or song?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we pay tribute to the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's musical legacy
angles.copy: Today would have been John Lennon's 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your go-to Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese!

angles.name: Cleese's comedic genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his wit is truly legendary. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the "White Album," on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album's experimental sound
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since we lost the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie's enduring showmanship
angles.copy: On this day, 35 years ago, we lost Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" released
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their influential album "Rubber Soul."

angles.name: Rubber Soul's musical shift
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' hit shelves. This album marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your pick from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Lennon's legacy of peace and music
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His message of peace and incredible music live on. What's the Lennon song that resonates most with you?

events.title: Remembering David Bowie, who would have been 80
events.blurb: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the life and artistry of the revolutionary David Bowie.

angles.name: Bowie's constant reinvention
angles.copy: Today would have been David Bowie's 80th birthday. A true innovator, he constantly reinvented himself and his music. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley, who would have been 92
events.blurb: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we pay tribute to the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Elvis's enduring impact
angles.copy: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. His music changed the world. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate the 83rd birthday of legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Page's iconic guitar riffs
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His guitar work with Led Zeppelin defined an era. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Happy 82nd birthday to the distinctive voice of rock and pop, Sir Rod Stewart!

angles.name: Rod Stewart's career longevity
angles.copy: Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today! Decades of hits, from rock anthems to classic covers. What's your all-time favourite Rod song?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate the 66th birthday of Graham "Suggs" McPherson, the iconic frontman of Madness.

angles.name: Suggs' unique contribution
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable frontman of Madness! His voice is synonymous with some of the greatest British tracks. What's your favourite Madness hit?
